enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn head to left. Turn head to right. Move right arm. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Sigh. Sleep.

Scoop cereal. Lift spoon to mouth. Eat. Chew. Swallow. Drink milk. Place spoon in bowl. Stand up. Carry bowl to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse bowl. Turn off tap. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close dishwasher.
